items.title: Block's AI layoffs taught it to be a far more efficient company: CFO
items.summary: Block, Inc. (XYZ) reduced its workforce by 40% earlier this year as it committed to a wider adoption of AI tools. Block CFO Amrita Ahuja sits down with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi to discuss this choice and the results from becoming a leaner, more AI-centric company.

items.title: Cathie Wood Just Bet $37 Million on Block. What It Means for XYZ Stock.
items.summary: Cathie Wood’s Ark Invest bought 456,059 Block shares worth about $37.4 million as the fintech pushes deeper into AI and cost-cutting.

items.title: XYZ Stock Upgraded To ‘Buy,’ Cantor Raises Targets On Crypto Plays, Sees Bear-Market Bottom
items.summary: StoneX analyst Mark Palmer upgraded Block to ‘Buy’ from ‘Hold’ and set a $105 price target, citing progress from the company’s AI-focused reorganization.

items.title: Jack Dorsey's Block makes major move to become a U.S. crypto bank

items.title: Block seeks national trust charter to offer crypto custody
items.summary: The payments fintech announced that it has applied for a national trust bank charter from the OCC for both bitcoin and stablecoin custody.

items.title: XYZ Files Application to Establish Builders Bank for Custody Services
items.summary: Block's proposed Builders Bank provide federally regulated custody services for bitcoin and stablecoins if approved by the OCC.
